assumptions.rule: Input coordinates quantised once by Math.round(metres * 1000); integer-mm geometry, exact 200000 mm grid, rounded integer-mm clip intersections and reused on-line endpoints. Disconnected simple components stay separate. Areas/orientations use BigInt; venue overlap requires exact intersection area >=1 mm2. Centres round once to mm; squared-distance comparisons use BigInt and id ties. Only the final index/report projection converts back to metres/m2. Venues first by place id, then (gx, gy); all venue volumes/Z bands retained. Venue precedence, then cell order on closed boundaries. Venue area is the XY footprint union; stacked volumes count once.

Grid edge neighbours, diagonal second neighbours; venues intersect actual clipped block polygons in XY. Geometry only; traversability unknown. Venue host is the nearest genuinely overlapping block centre by fixed-order squared distance, then cell id.

Clipped block area / sum of retained block areas; final block absorbs floating-point share residue so shares sum to exactly 1 in cell order. Report retained-minus-district area separately from per-cell headcount rounding; no subtraction of venue footprints. Venues have zero residents. S1 rounds headcounts per cell and draws households unchanged; realised household membership can differ.

Each person-entry period/spot link contributes quantity times span overlap / six hours to S1 windows starting 06:00, 12:00, 18:00, 00:00. Absent quantity means an unexported class default, treated as one unit, not a verified game default; explicit zero contributes nothing. Normalise once to the mean of the four stand-in district pop totals, derived from its original cell pop arrays independently of residential census/headcount (see population.standInPopTotals/popTarget/popMean). Presence has no per-period slot: one quantity/duration-weighted affiliation share over all spans. Exclude vehicle/other/unresolved affiliations; civilian/Unaffiliated merged, NCPD normalized. Alternative phases are summed as potential content, not asserted active. Legacy phases lacking periods use distinct all-day entry/spot links. Blocks without eligible person links get an all-day floor of 1% of mean block weight (mean 1 if all empty); explicit-zero links do not trigger a floor. Empty-weight presence uses census affiliation shares. No simultaneous occupancy claim.

periods.json is an assumption pending an in-game check: Morning 06:00, Day/Noon 12:00, Evening 18:00, Night 22:00, Midnight 00:00; valid _HH_MM labels use that clock time; H:MM AM/PM labels use a 12-hour clock (12:xx AM = 00:xx, 12:xx PM = 12:xx); all other labels run all day. Within each phase, known starts run to the next distinct start, wrapping midnight; duplicate starts share the span; a single start runs all day. Unknowns do not split known spans. Phase modes: absent/empty or all-unknown periods are all-day; otherwise single-period or multi-period by row count. allDay separately records whether every span is 24 hours.

One plain-kind table; nearest 15 by fixed-order squared 3D distance to footprint-weighted cell centre, ties by POI id. Market only when a retained POI service has a declared retail vendor type. Unknown kinds counted, never guessed. Evidence pins never become services.

All linked entry types retained; exact (community placement id, entry name, spot id), deduplicated only across phases of the same entry. Copy registry id and sourceObjectId alongside the placement id when supplied; absent legacy registry metadata is omitted, never invented. Ordinals unavailable; no runtime binding. Fallback ids counted by colon format.
Static counts by original POI kind only, separate from S1 fractional coverage. Calibration remains open.
2964, rho, age, role, income, affiliation, household, tenure and wealth marginals, trust and price anchor unchanged. W1 entry counts compare authored types, not quantities.

One named template per kind: block g4, venue v5 (see templates selection rules). Public, A, F and pairs are identical within each kind. Coverage reductions are zero until calibrated; markets come only from POI vendor services. Re-sum district staticTotalA; stub and rest totals unchanged. No claim of measured police/security, propensity, pair hostility or opportunity. S1Data defaults unchanged.

Period names/quantities and registry ids are optional for legacy input. W1 w1.7.1 supports them; no census flag, activation/conditions, entry cap or runtime binding is inferred. Records/spawners do not supply a census.

report.lineage: Different input content or geometry creates a new lineage. Origin-anchored grid keys are stable; ordinal member ids can shift when earlier cells are inserted.

block.name: g4
block.rule: Median headShare among public, service-free, non-market residential cells without coverage reductions.

venue.name: v5
venue.rule: First non-market stand-in venue in fixture order.
